intro: Wanted: Arnak Grimtotem is a Horde bounty posted at Freewind Post demanding the execution of a violent Grimtotem exile. Arnak is targeted by the local authorities for murder and kidnapping on the mesas above the canyon.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Arnak the outcast is wanted for the heinous crimes of murder and kidnapping. Handsome rewards will be given to those brave enough to bring this criminal to justice.
Arnak was last seen on the cliffs near the Darkcloud Pinnacle. Show the proof of your deed to Cliffwatcher Longhorn in Freewind Post in order to claim the reward.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you any news of that murderous Arnak Grimtotem?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Hah! Well, this is excellent news! I was starting to think that he would never be brought to justice!
Here you are, friend... And thanks. News of Arnak's foul deeds boiled my blood!

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
